_comment: Reviewed set of values each PUSH-table column can actually be given by a producer (till or cloud order-create), with the source that proves it. check-push-domain-parity.mjs diffs 'emits' against the FINAL cloud CHECK value-list; any emit the cloud rejects fails the gate (silent sync loss, the A128/A129 shape). Keep emits grounded in code — add a value only when a producer really writes it, and cite where.

orders.order_type.source: apps/desktop/.../POSPage.tsx chooseOrderType('dine_in'|'takeaway'|'delivery') + useState union incl. 'delivery'; apps/server/src/lib/schemas.ts order_type z.enum([...,'delivery']); parking_session/fuel_sale from parking & petrol flows

orders.source.source: till originates POS sales; qr/aggregator/online are cloud-side channels, never pushed from a till

orders.sync_status.source: syncEngine sets pending on create, synced after push; 'conflict' is cloud-resolved

payments.status.source: apps/desktop/src/main/*.ts payment status literals; 'refunded' is cloud-side

shifts.status.source: apps/desktop shift lifecycle; 'closed_unreconciled' set cloud-side on forced close (migration 41)

shifts.close_method.source: apps/desktop shift close path (counted | forced); NULL while open

customer_credit_transactions.type.source: till charges credit on order and records repayment; 'adjustment' is cloud/admin-side

business_days.status.source: apps/desktop business-day open/close lifecycle (migration 41 adds closed_unreconciled cloud-side on forced close)
